prompt: Match each operator surface to the monitoring or troubleshooting job it belongs to.
explanation: The Cluster Manager UI splits the work: alert thresholds are managed under Cluster > Alert Settings, the audit-style event stream lives under Cluster > Logs, and the Support entry in the navigation menu generates the support package. On the node itself, rlcheck runs the node health-check suite, and Cluster > Security > Certificates is where expiring certificates get rotated.

pairs.right: Enable and tune cluster and node alert thresholds
Review system and user events, including alerts
Generate a support package for Redis support
Run the health-check suite on a node
Rotate cluster certificates before they expire
